trello.name: Fix Staging Environment Deployment
trello.desc:
The deploy job in the staging environment has been red since this morning because it can't pull the base image due to an expired registry token. Steps to address this issue are: 
1. Regenerate the expired registry token.
2. Update the CI secret with the new token.
3. Re-run the deployment job.
Expected duration for fix: 1 hour. This task is critical because currently, nothing can be tested until this is resolved.

trello.name: Send Updated Proposal to Meridian
trello.desc:
Meridian has requested an updated proposal with new pricing, which needs to be delivered by the end of the day. The steps to complete this task are:
1. Take the final numbers from the spreadsheet.
2. Insert these numbers into the proposal document.
3. Send the updated proposal document to Lena, the procurement contact at Meridian. Her email address can be found in the kickoff thread.
This task is important and must be completed by the end of the day today.
